trajectory_summary: This call moves cleanly through verify with a customer who was already leaning in — rising electricity rates, EV charging, and high summer bills all surfaced unprompted. The rep executed the mechanical structure well (address, roof, title, credit, utility, bill request, scheduling) but left two real anchors on the table: the customer's detailed $350-400+ bill figure was logged and not flipped, and the wife (co-owner) was named but never invited onto the appointment. The call ends with a locked day and time, bill promised, but two structurally loose threads.
outcome_dispute: No prior outcome tag was provided to dispute.
